headline: This law makes the Bulletproof Vest Partnership grant program permanent and renames it after Senator Patrick Leahy.
what_it_does: The law removes the time limit on the Bulletproof Vest Partnership Program, so it no longer needs to be renewed on a set schedule. The program gives grants to state and local governments to buy body armor vests for police and other law enforcement officers. The law also renames the program the Patrick Leahy Bulletproof Vest Partnership Grant Program.

who_it_affects.how: They can continue to apply for federal grants to help buy body armor for their law enforcement officers without waiting for the program to be reauthorized.
Officers at participating departments may have access to federally funded body armor vests through their agencies.

when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 23, 2019.
